items.title: Beta 0.3.1 — liquid glass
items.body: The island now moves like liquid glass: it leans toward your cursor, squishes when you press it and pulses with the beat of your music. Cloudy got a cleaner look with big eyes and plays on his own more.

items.title: Your hotkey opens Home
items.body: Press Alt+Space (⌥Space on Mac) to open Home from anywhere. Press it again to close.

items.title: Music tab and widgets
items.body: Beta 0.3.0 added a Music tab with smooth lyrics and widgets you can arrange on Home. Tap Edit on Home to try it.
